title: Define safe multi-image request body limits and errors
outcome: The 16 MiB Axum request body cap accommodates one maximum-size pasted image but multiple valid attachments can exceed it before application validation, producing a bare 413 rather than the normal structured error. Define an explicit attachment count/aggregate-byte contract instead of relying on the transport cap.
acceptance: UI and backend agree on attachment count and aggregate encoded/request limits; valid supported multi-image sends fit under the route cap, oversized requests receive a clear structured error where possible, and tests cover single-max, multi-image, and over-limit cases without weakening DoS protection.
